scope: Compare search policies only after a complete attempt ledger is available; do not infer missing campaign actions from the published Figure 2.

eligibility.campaigns: Closed-loop inorganic solid-state synthesis campaigns with stable attempt IDs and complete candidate-set snapshots.

policies.name: uniform-eligible
policies.definition: Uniformly sample one currently eligible recipe–temperature action; the candidate-set snapshot fixes the denominator.

policies.name: thermodynamic-greedy
policies.definition: Choose the eligible action with the largest preregistered target-forming driving-force score without using observed intermediates.

policies.name: pairwise-path-avoidance
policies.definition: Exclude actions predicted to repeat an observed detrimental intermediate path, then maximize the same driving-force score.

policies.name: failure-calibrated-information-gain
policies.definition: Choose the action with maximum expected information gain over target success and failure mode after family-wise probability calibration.

primaryEndpoints: independently confirmed targets per executed experiment
experiments to first independently confirmed target
family-wise Brier score and nominal 90% interval coverage

replayFidelityGate.rule: If either threshold fails, report only a partial reconstruction and do not claim a causal policy comparison.

advanceRule: R2 or R3 must improve independently confirmed targets per experiment by at least 30% over both R0 and R1, with a bootstrap 95% interval excluding zero and the direction repeated in a held-out chemical family.
stopRules: Stop policy comparison if any attempt lacks a candidate-set snapshot, raw observation checksum, or final adjudication state.
Stop causal interpretation when deterministic action reconstruction fails the replay-fidelity gate and action probabilities are absent.
Stop scale-up when independent-adjudication disagreement exceeds 10% or nominal 90% interval coverage falls below 85% in any family.

uncertaintyBudget.control: blind independent refinement plus orthogonal assay
candidate-set hashes, code commit, scores, random seed, selection probability
chemical-family holdout and bootstrap by target rather than attempt
uncertaintyBudget.gate: 95% interval for policy difference excludes zero

uncertaintyBudget.control: report calibration separately for every held-out family
